mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (real GDP) signals robust demand, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in quarters with rising GDPC1 do not exceed baseline returns (t-test p > 0.05) or GDPC1's trend is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 3.5%, signaling monetary tightening, investors anticipate higher interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 3.5% or the rate's increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (disposable income) indicate strong consumer and business demand, creating a positive feedback loop that drives S&P 500 20-day returns upward.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 12-month average AND RSAFS exceeds 12-month average
failure_condition: The 20-day returns do not rise significantly when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are above their 12-month averages (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% reduces policy tightness, easing financial conditions and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS below 2% does not lead to positive 20d returns (IC < 0.03) or returns are not statistically higher than baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Short-term spikes in HOUST (industrial production) correlate with immediate demand surges, predicting positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not follow the direction of HOUST spikes (e.g., returns negative when HOUST rises).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 3% reduces labor cost pressures, fostering corporate profitability and positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not rise when UNRATE drops below 3% (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous upward movements in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) reflect a balanced macro environment, enhancing growth prospects and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 6-month average AND INDPRO exceeds 6-month average
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not increase when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are above their 6-month averages (IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery regime, a sharp drop in FEDFUNDS below 3% signals policy accommodation, accelerating market optimism and generating positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery, FEDFUNDS below 3% does not result in positive 5d returns (IC < 0.03).
